results.title: The Rise & Fall of the Colosseum
results.original_title: The Rise & Fall of the Colosseum
results.overview: The Colosseum: the jewel of Ancient Rome. It wowed vast crowds with extraordinary battles. It pushed the boundaries of technology. It exhibited Rome’s vast wealth and power. Roman leaders spread the Colosseum’s design throughout the Empire, and it helped them conquer the ancient world. But just as the structure embodied Rome’s power, so too did it contribute to the Empire’s downfall.

results.title: Sugarcane
results.overview: When Phoebe goes missing, Mari takes it upon herself to find her. With an old friend’s help, they uncover a sinister website linked to the kidnapping, forcing Mari to confront her past to save Phoebe before time runs out.

results.title: Feliz con las cuatro
results.overview: Pancracio is a man who has it all... and all the women. His reputation as a generous and passionate lover spreads through the town like an open secret amidst sheets, sighs, and knowing smiles.

results.title: Los Muértimer
results.overview: It tells the story of five friends who discover a jewel theft plot in a cemetery without any adult believing them.

results.title: Can You See?
results.overview: Teresa's peaceful life is turned upside down when a stain on her kitchen window is declared a miracle. As pilgrims flock to the house and her husband, Henryk, blossoms in the spotlight, Teresa feels increasingly invisible. Torn between her faith, societal expectations, and her own desires, she struggles to regain a sense of self in a world that ignores her.

results.title: Correveidiles Teatro: Christmas is here
results.original_title: Correveidiles Teatro: Ya está aquí la Navidad
results.overview: Music video for the song by Correveidiles Teatro: "Christmas is here".

results.title: Solar Queen
results.overview: In this film, shot in Drachhausen/Hochoza in southern Brandenburg, film students from Potsdam reinterpret Schiller's play ‘Die Jungfrau von Orleans’ (The Maid of Orleans) and set it in Lower Lusatia. Johanna, the harvest queen, campaigns for the expansion of a solar park. She is celebrated by many for this, but some are hostile towards her. After the cock plucking/łapanje kokota, a scandal erupts in the ballroom.

results.title: Cama Baldía
results.overview: In a forgotten village, a woman lives as the last inhabitant of a place filled with shadows and silences. One night, she finds herself trapped in a disturbing nightmare: a wake where ghosts pray and a single empty grave awaits. This strange ritual forces her to confront the limits of her memory, where the past and the echoes of her existence intertwine with death, revealing hidden truths about her loneliness.

results.title: One Last Show in Taghmon
results.overview: In 1982, in a small rural village, the stuntmen, down on their luck and having never made it into the big league, embark on a journey to the village of Taghmon to perform One Last Show.

results.title: Barren Land
results.overview: Barren Land is the story of three friends. All three trapped between the abandonment of the institutions, the violent and unstoppable rise of the narco in the province and the dangerous increase of social discontent. Three friends trapped in a powder keg that will test their friendship.

results.title: Jurassic World Rebirth: The Making of a New Era
results.original_title: Jurassic World Rebirth: The Making of a New Era
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes look with the cast and crew, featuring thrilling locations, deadly new dinosaurs and the next evolution of the iconic franchise.

results.title: The Pursuit of Lust 5
results.overview: VMX Crush Vern Kaye takes the spotlight in this erotic drama, which follows a foreign couple on a trip to the Philippines, where they meet an enchanting local photographer. What began as an attempt to rekindle the lovers’ spark soon develops into an unexpected threesome.

results.title: Miyazaki, Spirit of Nature
results.overview: A documentary that focuses on Hayao Miyazaki’s deep connection to nature and the environmental themes expressed through his films.

results.title: Kid Racers
results.overview: Follows five contenders, ages 8 and 9 years old, as they compete in the Beginner Box Stock class, against better funded competitors from leading NASCAR families.

results.title: All the Lost Ones
results.overview: In a dystopian and climate-ravaged future America torn apart by civil war, a group hiding in a remote cabin become the target of a ruthless rebel militia leader and his platoon, viciously hunted in a fight for survival.

results.title: Territory
results.overview: Adam, a new policeman in town, discovers through surveillance cameras that his police colleagues are involved in covering up the rape of a young girl.

results.title: Melt
results.overview: How do people live in snowbound areas? What are the mechanisms for simply moving snow around? How have ski resorts mechanised what ought to be a natural process? A comprehensive study of global warming as it is directly experienced by arctic and alpine communities.

results.title: The Evaluation
results.overview: In an academic committee where student performances are judged, a newcomer lecturer must decide: confront the power she once respected or stay silent to belong.

results.title: Captain Zero: Into the Abyss Part II
results.original_title: Captain Zero: Into the Abyss Part II
results.overview: Framed through his therapy sessions, high school senior Xerxes Hughes struggles to juggle his double life as a student and superhero, all while trying to confront his inner demon—literally.
